facts.text: Applicants who do not meet freshman admission standards can be jointly admitted to UHD and a partner community college through the Gator Guarantee, completing 24 core hours before transferring.

sources.title: Admission Requirements - University of Houston Downtown
sources.quote: Students who do not meet the UHD admissions criteria, will be referred to a partner community college. They will be jointly admitted to UHD and to the community college as a Gator Guarantee Community College student.

concerns: Information sourced from archived 2019-2020 catalog page, the most specific official source found.
